test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the following sentence.

One should celebrate every __triumph__ in life.
solution: The correct answer is **'Defeat'.** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **Triumph **means a great success or victory; the feeling of happiness that you have because of this. (महान सफलता या विजय; सफलता या विजय का उल्‍लास) • **Example**- They march victorious across the world, beating their drums in **triumph**. • **Defeat **means to win a game, a fight, a vote, etc. against somebody; to beat somebody. (किसी पर विजय प्राप्‍त करना; किसी को हराना) • Example- She's a person who will never admit **defeat.** • **​**It is clear from the above explanations that the antonym of the given word is **'Defeat'.** ​Therefore, the correct answer is** 'Option 4'.** ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • **Milestone **is a significant event in your life. **(मील का पत्थर)** • **Victory **means** **success in winning a battle, game, competition, etc. **(युद्घ, खेल, स्‍पर्धा आदि में सफलता, विजय, जीत, फ़तह)** • **Instrument **means** **a tool that is used for doing a particular job or task. **(कार्य विशेष का उपकरण)** 14b:Tafd, The correct answer is **"Option 3"**.
